{{Top|leg}}
'''Pleasure houses''' were entertainment businesses located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adner]]. Alongside [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] and [[amusement park]]s, pleasure houses were frequented by hundreds of thousands of tourists and thrill-seekers. The pleasure houses were adept at thrilling and pampering the visitors, having been in operation for over two thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. The businesses were usually run by large [[Steris|steri]], overseen by [[Adnerem]] managers and employing [[Alien/Legends|alien]] workers.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
